name: Community Bancorp

sections.title: Diluted earnings per share by quarter
sections.callout: Q4 2025: diluted EPS of $0.83, up from $0.73 a year earlier.

footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue (net interest income + noninterest income) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving pre-tax income. Efficiency ratio = noninterest expense ÷ revenue (lower is better).
Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) rose 16.7% to $48.8M in 2025. Net interest income rose 18.0% to $40.9M and noninterest income rose 10.1% to $7.9M; noninterest expense rose 6.0%, and the provision for credit losses was $1.4M, versus $1.2M.
Net income rose 32.9% to $17.0M, or $3.01 per diluted share, and the efficiency ratio was 55.4% versus 60.9%. Community Bancorp returned $4.0M through dividends.
watch: Net interest income depends on interest rates.
sources: Community Bancorp Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
